styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.SAMBONG: a man in his fifties, white cotton band round his forehead, never a hat, worn white hemp jacket, a rope on one shoulder
characters.SCHOLAR: a grown man about thirty wearing a black gat, clearly an adult and never a boy, plain durumagi
characters.SECOND: a man in his forties in white hemp mourning clothes, a black head cloth over his topknot and a black tie, a hard face
characters.BIER: a Korean funeral bier: a flat square white cloth canopy with red and blue borders on four poles, under it a coffin box painted in plain red green and yellow stripes with no faces and no portraits on it, small flags at the corners, carried on long beams
characters.FATHER: a very thin old man in a pale undyed hemp jacket, a grey topknot tied up and never bald, in his seventies, unshaven and weak

scenes.S01: Every man wears plain white hemp. A funeral procession seen from behind on a mountain path, all backs turned, carrying BIER. Wide autumn hills. Daylight.
scenes.S02: A close view of SAMBONG with a long wooden beam resting flat across his shoulder, one hand steadying it from below, the beam running away in front of and behind him. His eyes narrowed, feeling the weight. Autumn daylight.
scenes.S05: SAMBONG sitting alone on a low stone wall at the edge of a village, a coil of thick rope over his shoulder, looking down the road. Daylight, nobody else.
scenes.S06: [SIL] Sunset over a village road, a funeral procession walking as black silhouettes with the tall bier among them, layered gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold behind them.
scenes.S07: Only one person: SAMBONG standing with one shoulder raised as if a beam rested on it, his eyes closed, feeling something. A village yard behind. Daylight, nobody else.
scenes.S08: White hemp trousers and straw sandals: a close view of the lower legs and feet of several men in plain white hemp climbing a steep stony path, no colored clothing at all. No faces. Autumn daylight.
scenes.S09: [SIL] Sunset over a mountain ridge, a line of bier bearers walking as black silhouettes with the tall bier between them, layered gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold behind them.
scenes.S10: A large tiled roof house behind a long wall, white mourning cloth hung at the gate, a few servants hurrying in and out. Daylight, no large faces.
scenes.S11: Only one person in the picture: SECOND standing alone in the courtyard of a large tiled house in white hemp mourning clothes, his hands clasped in front of him, his face composed. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S12: BIER standing alone in a deserted courtyard, nobody near it, white mourning cloth on the wall behind. Daylight.
scenes.S13: A close view of SAMBONG's shoulder under the bier beam, his hand gripping the rope, his face suddenly still and puzzled. Daylight, blurred mourners behind.
scenes.S14: A close view filling the frame: SAMBONG's face and one shoulder, the wooden beam resting flat on it, his head turned back and his eyes narrowed, troubled. Nobody else. Autumn daylight.
scenes.S16: SAMBONG walking down a mountain path alone at dusk, his head down, his rope coiled over his shoulder. Nobody else, fading light.
scenes.S17: Only one person: SAMBONG lying awake on a straw mat in a small dark room, his eyes open, staring at the ceiling. Night, nobody else.
scenes.S18: Only one person: SCHOLAR standing at a village gate with a travel bundle, looking at a house hung with white mourning cloth. No floating faces, nobody else. Daylight.
scenes.S19: Exactly two men indoors: the young scholar holding up a land deed with a shocked face, and an old servant kneeling with his head bowed. Daylight, paper documents on a low table.
scenes.S20: Exactly two people in a room: SCHOLAR standing angry, and SECOND sitting calm with his arms folded, a low table between them. Daylight indoors.
scenes.S21: Every man has a full topknot or a black gat, no shaved forehead, no caps and no visors. A village street with people standing in small groups talking quietly, glancing toward a big tiled house. Daylight, no large faces.
scenes.S23: Only one person in the picture: SAMBONG standing alone outside the closed gate of a large tiled house, his rope on his shoulder, hesitating with one hand half raised toward the gate. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S24: SAMBONG kneeling low with his head bowed, and SCHOLAR standing before him listening, startled. Exactly two people, daylight.
scenes.S25: A close view of the young scholar's face, eyes wide, mouth half open, pale. Blurred village background. Nobody else.
scenes.S26: SAMBONG kneeling and speaking with one hand on his own shoulder, SCHOLAR sitting and listening. Exactly two people, daylight indoors.
scenes.S27: Every man has a full topknot or a black gat, no shaved forehead, no caps and no visors. Several villagers with shovels around an opened grave mound on a hillside, SCHOLAR in front and SECOND beside him protesting. Daylight.
scenes.S28: A close view of an opened wooden coffin on a hillside, inside it a heap of round river stones and nothing else, hands pulling the lid aside. Daylight, no faces.
scenes.S30: SECOND stands with his wrists tied together in front of him by a short rope, two constables in black holding him by the upper arms on either side. No long rope stretched between people. Villagers watch. Daylight.
scenes.S31: A close view filling the frame: FATHER lying on a thin mat in a dim back room, one hand raised weakly, a folded quilt and a low water bowl beside him. Plain walls, no writing. Nobody else.
scenes.S32: Two people indoors: SCHOLAR kneeling and holding the hand of FATHER, who sits propped up. Daylight.
scenes.S33: SCHOLAR bowing deeply toward SAMBONG, who steps back with one hand raised. A courtyard, daylight.
scenes.S34: An old man in a black gat holding out a thick string of round brass coins with square holes in the middle, never paper money and no banknotes, and SAMBONG stepping back with one palm raised. A house gate, daylight.
scenes.S35: SAMBONG speaking quietly with one hand gesturing low, SCHOLAR listening with a serious face. Exactly two people in a courtyard, daylight.
scenes.S36: A close view of several pairs of new straw sandals laid in a row on a wooden veranda filling the frame, two men in hemp crouching to pick them up. No signboard and no writing anywhere. Daylight.
scenes.S37: [SIL] Sunset over a mountain path, one man with a coil of rope on his shoulder walking alone as a black silhouette, layered silver clouds and a band of gold light behind him.
